sampling: At every fixed fixture waypoint time and every emitted analysis sample, retain each anchor ID, sample time, visibility, source lon/lat, expected/observed pixel coordinates, viewport, DPR, and actual camera basis/projection. Keep off-screen raw values but score only visible probes.

expected_projection.method: independent scalar orthographic projection from source query and actual fixture/view state

observed_projection.method: Camera3D.unproject_position(active terrain triangle CPU probe) using actual runtime basis and projection; no framebuffer feature recognition

aggregation: maximum Euclidean 2D distance in pixels; no RMS aggregation and no rounding
a16_separation: A16 surface/generalization limits screen_error_px=2 and transition_residual_px=1 are separate; they do not change this A05 limit.

nominal_controls.meaning: Original fixed geographic route controls and zoom values; the runtime harness continues to drive these values.

effective_fixture_states.meaning: The fixture binds deterministic full-precision Camera3D state observed by a separate controller-only regression; this is the exact expected state used by the strict Kit validator, not an A05 measurement.

controller_regression.scope: 2-second controller/serialization regression only; no A05 score and no acceptance evidence.

fixture_control_binding.serialization: Godot JSON serialization uses FULL_PRECISION=true so source anchor coordinates round-trip exactly as IEEE-754 values.
